analysis.title: Secure Campus Wi-Fi Management System
analysis.summary: A university deploys a secure campus-wide Wi-Fi system that enables wireless access for students, faculty, staff, and guests while enforcing centralized authentication, role-based access control, and monitoring of unauthorized access attempts. The system supports device-level policies and provides administrators with configuration, inspection, and revocation capabilities.

assessments.explanation: The system must provide wireless access to students, faculty, staff, and guests across academic buildings, hostels, laboratories, and administrative offices.

The system shall use centralized authentication, role-based access control, separate guest access from internal university resources, monitor active wireless sessions, detect repeated authentication failures and unauthorized access attempts, and generate security alerts.
Network administrators must be able to configure wireless access policies, review connected devices, revoke access, and inspect audit logs.
The solution shall support university-managed and approved personal devices and remain secure, scalable, reliable, and manageable across multiple campus locations.

unresolved_decisions: What conditions define repeated authentication failures?
What conditions define unauthorized access attempts?
What retention period is required for the audit logs?
